objective: Promote domain models that preserve valid alternatives and their correlations, establish runtime evidence at owned boundaries, and make invalid states difficult to construct without rejecting legitimate APIs.

policy.nativeOwnersRetained: Existing strict compiler options, Any/unsafe-return rules, exhaustiveness controls and schema/record owners retain their scope. No blanket ban on guards, overloads, methods, mutable values, optional fields, open records, enums, naive wall time or nominal constructors.

passes.smallestFix: Extend the existing direct-typeof owner to empty targets with a proven successful input kind; no autofix.

evidence.closingValidation: Native-accepted unmarked imported methods and mutable-field overrides establish that the optional marker cannot be a correctness condition; narrowing public mutable fields produces reportIncompatibleVariableOverride. Native generic class subscription, escaped class handles, classmethod/constructor mutation and descriptor __set_name__ all demonstrate that apparently empty local bases can acquire the public contract. The final policy therefore makes no closed-world local-base claim. ciAndMerge.policy: All latest exact-head CI checks must pass before administrative squash merge. The GitHub pull request records the checks and merge revision; semantic source pins identify the reviewed detector implementations.

closingReview: Overload reachability depends on strict null policy: with loose null checking an earlier signature can mask a later null overload. Native TS5/TS6 controls require abstention there and retain strict/null and loose/non-null positives.

NamedTuple constructor defaults do not remove named attributes. Zero-field NamedTuples still expose nominal record methods absent from plain tuples. Both obligations are native/runtime-proven under carryforward G23, without increasing the phase-two pass count.

Inherited contracts can exist without an override marker. Withdraw these design recommendations for classes with explicit bases, including object, because runtime customization and escaped handles defeat local closed-member inference. Plain classes with implicit object and module functions remain eligible.

One exact baseline corpus source crashes SARJ093 while parsing a lone-surrogate forward annotation. Preserve the failed baseline evidence and distinguish recovered 3338-file SARJ093 coverage from the full candidate. Shared annotation, parser and tokenizer boundaries now reject unencodable input without inventing domain facts; every registered rule is exercised by the regressions.

Assignment validation does not imply rollback: an after-model validator may reject a mutation after storing it. Validated replacement or an owned atomic transition is necessary when publishing a cross-field invariant.
limitations: Observed zero false positives in labeled decisions and inspected candidate deltas is finite evidence, not a guarantee for all programs. New warnings have no unseeded positives in these historical corpora, so empirical precision on unseen defects is not estimable.

The historical corpora and prior labeled panels reuse immutable files from earlier campaigns; replayed files and synthetic seeds are not new independent consumer observations. Counts of policy diagnostics are not counts of demonstrated runtime defects.

The existing-domain baseline has one isolated UnicodeEncodeError file for SARJ093; the other selected owners complete that file. Conservative inherited-contract withdrawals can remove ambiguous opportunities as well as proven false positives.

Native proofs distinguish intentional compiler rejections from accepted runtime failures. Runtime/version/dependency matrices are separate observations of the same design obligation, not additional passes.

Warnings deliberately abstain on unsupported effects, opaque types, APIs, runtime replacements, ambiguous provenance and public ownership. Type guards remain useful at validation and refinement boundaries; merely replacing their syntax does not establish a domain invariant.

Performance panels measure selected/native combined analyzers on fixed local inputs. Fresh-process observations do not reset OS caches; unrelated shared-machine load is uncontrolled. No universal throughput or causal speedup claim.
